Gianicolense — Rome, Italy

Average day Average night

In detail

Gianicolense covers a residential stretch around Circonvallazione Gianicolense in the Monteverde area. Italian press research found multiple documented incidents specifically on or near this street: an armed jewellery-store robbery with a kitchen knife, a home invasion where a man posing as a postman tied up a woman during a gunpoint robbery, a failed robbery followed by vandalism of a flower kiosk in revenge, a bat-armed robbery at a minimarket, and a February 2026 case of cars torched between Primavalle and Gianicolense linked to cocaine home-delivery dealing. This is a real, recurring pattern of robberies rather than an isolated event, so both day and night are rated yellow.
